# 1 Enoch Chapter 37 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**37:1** The-second-vision which-he-saw, the-vision of-wisdom — which Enoch the-son of-Jared, the-son of-Mahalalel, the-son of-Cainan, the-son of-Enos, the-son of-Seth, the-son of-Adam saw.

**37:2** This-is the-beginning of-the-words of-wisdom, which I-lifted-up my-voice to-speak and-to-say to-those-who-dwell upon the-dry-ground: "Hear, ye men of-old-time, and-see, ye who-come-after, the-words of-the-Holy-One which-I-will-speak before the-Lord of-Spirits."

**37:3** "It-would-have-been-better to-declare [these-things] to-the-men of-old-time, but-even from-those who-come-after we-will-not-withhold the-beginning of-wisdom."

**37:4** "Until the-present-day such-wisdom has-never-been-given by-the-Lord of-Spirits as-I-have-received according to-my-insight, according to-the-good-pleasure of-the-Lord of-Spirits by-whom the-lot of-eternal-life has-been-given to-me."

**37:5** "Now three-parables were-imparted to-me, and-I-lifted-up my-voice and-recounted-them to-those-who-dwell upon the-dry-ground."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text following Charles (1906) and Knibb (1978) recensions. Ch. 37 is the prologue to the Book of Parables (chs. 37–71), absent from all Qumran DSS. "Lord of Spirits" (Ge'ez: 'egzi'a manafest) is the characteristic divine title throughout the Parables. "Dry-ground" preserves yābaśt, distinguishing land from sea.*
